headline: Ukraine Faces a $27 Billion Gap in War Financing: Costs Reach $155 Billion in 2026
summary: Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said total war costs will reach $155 billion this year. The government is struggling to close a $27 billion gap needed to fund operations into early 2027.
why: War financing needs drive Ukraine's sovereign borrowing, its reliance on international aid and the credit risk of its debt.

original_headline: Ukraina përballet me një hendek 27 miliardë dollarësh në financimin e luftës: kostot arrijnë 155 miliardë dollarë në 2026
